summary: Build the target containerized inventory with the same topology, and set the database names and secret keys from `secrets.yml`, either as inventory variables (`controller_pg_database`, `controller_secret_key`, `gateway_*`, `hub_*`, and `__hub_database_fields` from `hub_db_fields_encryption_key`) or with `-e @~/artifact/secrets.yml -e "__hub_database_fields='{{ hub_db_fields_encryption_key }}'"`. Then install, confirm PostgreSQL 15, back up and check the fresh install.
questions: How do I set the migrated secret keys in the containerized inventory?
How do I pass secrets.yml to the containerized installer?
Should I back up the new environment before importing?

answer_card.title: Install the target with source secrets
answer_card.answer_md:
Either add to the inventory:
```ini
controller_pg_database=<...>
controller_secret_key=<...>
gateway_pg_database=<...>
gateway_secret_key=<...>
hub_pg_database=<...>
hub_secret_key=<...>
__hub_database_fields=<hub_db_fields_encryption_key>
```
or pass the file:
```bash
ansible-playbook -i inventory ansible.containerized_installer.install \
  -e @~/artifact/secrets.yml \
  -e "__hub_database_fields='{{ hub_db_fields_encryption_key }}'"
```
Then back up: `ansible-playbook -i <inventory> ansible.containerized_installer.backup`.
